attributes.body_ja:
五段動詞（ごだんどうし）「関（かか）わる」が「に」と結（むす）びつくと、(A) と (B) の関係（かんけい）を示（しめ）すために使（つか）われます。この文型（ぶんけい）は「(A) に関係（かんけい）して、(B)」や「(A) に影響（えいきょう）する (B)」のような意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。

「にかかわる」は名詞（めいし）の後（うし）ろに置（お）かれ、この文型（ぶんけい）が別（べつ）の名詞（めいし）を修飾（しゅうしょく）する場合（ばあい）はその直後（ちょくご）に別（べつ）の名詞（めいし）が続（つづ）きます。また、この文型（ぶんけい）はひらがなで書（か）かれることが多（おお）いです。

この文型（ぶんけい）は、(A) が悪（わる）い結果（けっか）を引（ひ）き起（お）こす可能性（かのうせい）があるとき、話（はな）し手（て）が注意（ちゅうい）を促（うなが）すために使（つか）われることもあります。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「にかかわる」と似（に）ている文型（ぶんけい）に「に関（かん）する」がありますが、「にかかわる」は「に関（かん）する」よりも (A) と (B) の間（あいだ）により深（ふか）く、より重要（じゅうよう）な繋（つな）がりがあることを示（しめ）すという違（ちが）いがあります。そのため、この二（ふた）つは完全（かんぜん）に同（おな）じ意味（いみ）で使（つか）うことはできません。
attributes.body:
When grouped with に, the う-Verb 関（かか）わる 'to be concerned with' is frequently used to show a relation between (A) and (B). This grammar pattern may be translated as 'relating to (A), (B)', 'concerning (A), (B)', or '(B) that has to do with (A)'.

This structure appears after nouns, and is occasionally followed directly to a second noun in order to modify its meaning. Also, it is most common to see this pattern in its non-kanji form.

This grammar pattern may also highlight that (A) is something that the speaker should be cautious about, due to a potential negative outcome.

Caution

Despite being similar to に関（かん）する, にかかわる implies a deeper, more important relationship between (A) and (B), so they are not completely interchangeable.

attributes.source: A Handbook of Japanese Grammar Patterns

attributes.description: What's the difference between 関する and かかわる
Express Various Targets: に対して, について, and にかかわる

attributes.body: These expressions share the verb かかわる but have opposite functions. にかかわる describes a relation or connection, often serious, as in 命にかかわる問題 (A matter of life and death). にもかかわらず is adverbial, expressing contrast or contradiction, as in 年齢にもかかわらず (Regardless of age).

first_relatable.title: にもかかわらず
first_relatable.meaning: Despite, In spite of, Regardless, Nevertheless

second_relatable.title: にかかわる
second_relatable.meaning: To relate to, To have to do with, Concerning, Depends on

attributes.body: Both patterns relate to a topic, but differ in meaning, tone, and grammatical usage. について means 'about (A)' or 'concerning (A)' and attaches to verb phrases, e.g. スポーツについて話す ('Talk about sports'), while にかかわる is more formal and attaches to nouns, typically describing a more serious or consequential relationship, such as one involving life, health, or major repercussions, e.g. 命にかかわる問題 ('A life-threatening issue').

second_relatable.title: にかかわる
second_relatable.meaning: To relate to, To have to do with, Concerning, Depends on

attributes.body: Both follow nouns to express the idea of being related to or having to do with something, but they differ in nuance and structure. に関する・に関して attaches to a noun to mean 'about (A)' or 'concerning (A)', e.g. 歴史に関する本 ('a book about history'). にかかわる also connects to nouns but often implies a more serious or impactful relationship, e.g. 命にかかわる問題 ('a life-threatening issue').

second_relatable.title: にかかわる
second_relatable.meaning: To relate to, To have to do with, Concerning, Depends on

attributes.body: While both にかかわる and において・における describe relationships with nouns, their meanings differ. にかかわる expresses significant relevance or impact, often with serious subjects, e.g. '命にかかわる' ('a matter of life'). において・における simply marks context without implying influence, e.g. '歴史において重要な事件' ('an important event in history').

second_relatable.title: において・における
second_relatable.meaning: In, On, At, Regarding, In terms of

attributes.body: 次第 emphasizes timing or sequencing, used to express that one action is a condition for the next, which will follow immediately. For example, 準備ができ次第出発します ('As soon as preparations are done, we'll depart'). にかかわる focuses on relevance or importance, describing how something affects or relates to another matter. For example, 命にかかわる問題 ('a matter of life').
